name: web.aeo
description: AI-search and answer-engine readiness for a business page: can ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI features and classic search extract, trust and quote the business accurately. Input is an evidence dossier of measured page facts (served HTML, JSON-LD, headings, text).

aeo_entity_clarity.instructions: Can a machine reader extract who the business is, what it sells, where, and for whom from the first screen of text? (family L, weight 3)
criteria: Plus the founder or operator named
Plus a one-sentence definition quotable as-is
Plus the same definition restated in title, meta and H1
Entity fully defined in quotable sentences, consistent across title, meta, H1 and schema

aeo_structured_data_depth.instructions: How complete and valid is the structured data (JSON-LD) for search and AI engines? (family L, weight 3)
criteria: Business type with address or service area
Rich, valid, mutually consistent graph: business, person, services, offers, FAQ

aeo_llms_txt.instructions: Is there a machine-readable site summary (llms.txt or equivalent) at the domain that states offer, prices and boundaries? (family L, weight 1)
criteria: Plus links that match the sitemap
Complete, current, and consistent with the site and schema

aeo_faq_answerable.instructions: Does the page answer the buyer's likely questions in direct question-and-answer form? (family L, weight 2)
criteria: FAQs on price, process and scope
Direct one-sentence answers first, detail after
Comprehensive, direct, quotable answers to real buyer questions

aeo_quotable_facts.instructions: Does the page contain specific, self-contained facts an AI assistant could quote (prices, timelines, scope limits, deliverables)? (family L, weight 2)
criteria: Facts present but need surrounding context
Standalone facts on price and scope
Dense, standalone, mutually consistent facts across the page

aeo_nap_consistency.instructions: Are business name, location and contact route explicit and consistent for local search? (family L, weight 1)
criteria: Name and city, no contact route
Name, city and a contact form
Consistent across page text and schema
Plus street address or verifiable registration
Full, consistent name, location and contact in text and schema, with service area

aeo_price_machine_readable.instructions: Are prices and quote-only offers stated consistently in page text and structured data? (family L, weight 2)
criteria: Prices in text, none in schema
Prices in schema, not in text
Plus quote-only offers explicitly marked as quoted
Every offer's price or quote status consistent in text and schema

aeo_crawlable_content.instructions: Is core content present in served HTML with a semantic heading hierarchy and landmarks? (family L, weight 2)
criteria: Fully server-rendered, semantic, landmarked and descriptive

aeo_topical_depth.instructions: Does the site offer dedicated, linked pages per service and per vertical that an AI engine could cite for specific queries? (family L, weight 2)
criteria: Vertical pages linked from the page
Complete, interlinked topical cluster per service and vertical

aeo_third_party_corroboration.instructions: Are there verifiable third-party signals (directories, profiles, reviews, citations) that corroborate the business? (family L, weight 1)

aeo_freshness.instructions: Does the content show it is current (dates, recent updates, current-year facts)? (family L, weight 1)
criteria: Clearly current across page and schema

rules.reason: machine reader cannot tell what the business sells
